claim.claim-text: 1. A method of operating a fluid dispenser (10), the fluid dispenser (10) comprising:

2. The method according to claim 1, further comprising: controlling a function of one or more electronic components of the fluid dispenser (10) based on the detection data received from the light sensor (120).

3. The method according to claim 2, wherein controlling the function of the one or more electronic components of the fluid dispenser (10) based on the detection data received from the light sensor (120) comprises controlling the function of the one or more electronic components based on whether the pump mechanism (42) has been activated.

4. The method according to claim 2, wherein controlling the function of the one or more electronic components of the fluid dispenser (10) based on the detection data received from the light sensor (120) comprises controlling the function of the one or more electronic components based on a length of time since the pump mechanism (42) was last activated.

5. The method according to any one of claims 2 to 4, wherein the one or more electronic components comprises a pump position sensor (94), the method further comprising: sensing a property of the fluid dispenser (10) that is indicative of a position of the pump mechanism (42) using the pump position sensor (94).

6. The method according to claim 5, wherein controlling the function of the pump position sensor (94) based on the detection data received from the light sensor (120) comprises activating the pump position sensor (94) when the pump mechanism (42) has been activated.

7. The method according to claim 5, wherein controlling the function of the pump position sensor (94) based on the detection data received from the light sensor (120) comprises inactivating the pump position sensor (94) when the pump mechanism (42) has been inactive for a set period of time.
8. The method according to any one of claims 5 to 7, further comprising determining the position of the pump mechanism (42) over time based on sensor data from the pump position sensor (94).

9. The method according to claim 8, further comprising calculating or estimating a volume of fluid (60) that has been dispensed from the fluid dispenser (10) over time based on the position of the pump mechanism (42) over time.
10. The method according to claim 9, further comprising:

comparing the volume of fluid (60) that has been dispensed from the fluid dispenser (10) during an activation event to a threshold volume; and determining whether the volume of fluid (60) dispensed during the activation event exceeds the threshold volume.
11. The method according to claim 10, further comprising providing an indication to a user when the volume of fluid (60) dispensed during the activation event exceeds the threshold volume.

12. The method according to claim 10 or claim 11, wherein the fluid dispenser (10) further comprises a magnet (102) that moves relative to the pump position sensor (94) when the pump mechanism (42) is activated;
13. The method according to claim 12, further comprising orienting the second magnet sensor (106) at 90 degrees relative to the first magnet sensor (104).

14. The method according to claim 12 or claim 13, wherein the fluid dispenser (10) further comprises an actuator plate (36) that engages with the pump mechanism (42) to activate the pump mechanism (42);

wherein the magnet (102) is attached to the actuator plate (36); and wherein detecting movement of the movable component using the light sensor (120) comprises detecting light reflected from the actuator plate (36).

15. The method according to claim 14, further comprising positioning a cover (40) of the fluid dispenser (10) adjacent to the actuator plate (36), the cover (40) carrying the light sensor (120), the first magnet sensor (104), and the second magnet sensor (106);

wherein the fluid dispenser (10) further comprises a data communication device (90) that is operable to communicate with a mobile communication device carried by a user; the method further comprising:
